statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the 25% block threshold while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains WATCH. The current session has opened near the prior settlement; higher Tail bands require persistent directional extension, weak retracements and broader cross-asset confirmation.
headline: Globex reopens nearly flat while oil, rates and geopolitical stress remain elevated
body: Delayed NQ was 29,506.75 at 00:04 UTC, only 6.25 points below the prior 29,513 close, with the new session opening at that level and no directional extension yet visible. Reuters reported Brent at $90.49 and the U.S. 10-year yield at 4.758% amid renewed U.S.-Iran attacks; Cboe VIX ended at 15.08, up 4.50%.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 20% to 30%. It was elevated at 00:00-02:00 UTC and 08:00 UTC, with all later hours in WATCH. Stress remained extreme at 97-99%, and the dominant mode shifted from event/whipsaw to mixed at 21:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail is lowest during quiet overnight rotation and rises toward the 13:00-15:15 UTC danger window spanning Barr, the U.S. cash open and the 14:00 JOLTS/ISM Manufacturing/Construction Spending cluster. Stress stays extreme around the event window; higher Tail requires observed directional efficiency rather than event importance alone.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ at 00:04 UTC was 29,506.75, only 6.25 points below the prior close; the new Globex session opened near settlement with no one-way extension yet visible.

forecast.analysis: If the near-settlement Globex open develops into two-sided early-Asia trade, Tail stays at the low end of WATCH; a headline-driven gap that extends without retracement would be adverse.
If two-sided trade persists through early Asia, conditional Tail slips to low; persistent directional extension across successive pullback attempts would invalidate that decline.
Mid-Asia remains low Tail under orderly rotation. Oil and Treasury yields become stronger path amplifiers only if NQ begins holding an extreme and retracements fail.
Late-Asia Tail stays low if the overnight range continues to overlap. A held session extreme with repeated shallow pullbacks would shift the structure toward WATCH.
The Europe handoff raises conditional Tail back to WATCH because a durable breakout could establish directional efficiency; range re-entry would keep the move contained.
The European open tests whether overnight direction broadens across equities and rates. Failed continuation keeps Tail contained; aligned extension would raise concern.
Early European trade remains WATCH if NQ rotates around the overnight range. Rising yields matter more for Tail only if price extension persists with weak pullbacks.
With the U.S. event cluster still several hours away, Tail stays WATCH unless Europe establishes a persistent directional sequence that survives meaningful retracement attempts.
Late European morning risk centers on whether overnight extremes are accepted or rejected; rejection supports two-sided structure, while repeated extension would lift conditional Tail.
U.S. premarket liquidity begins to matter more. Tail remains WATCH unless oil, yields and index direction align with a sustained move that resists retracement.
Approaching the U.S. data window, event dispersion raises Stress more than Tail. Conditional Tail rises modestly because premarket direction may become more persistent.
The hour before Barr and the cash open carries higher transition risk. Tail remains below the block threshold unless a premarket trend holds extremes with shallow pullbacks.

Barr speaks at 13:05 UTC and the U.S. cash session opens at 13:30 UTC. Tail reaches the top of WATCH conditionally; sustained opening-auction continuation with weak retracements is the key adverse path.
JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and Construction Spending arrive at 14:00 UTC. Tail stays at the top of WATCH until observed post-release structure shows either orderly retracement or persistent extension.
The first full post-release hour tests whether the 14:00 UTC repricing persists. Tail eases within WATCH if pullbacks broaden; repeated extension after failed retracements would keep risk higher.
Later U.S. morning trade should clarify whether the event move has normalized. Two-sided rotation reduces conditional Tail; a held extreme with cross-asset alignment would delay normalization.
By midday, Tail trends lower if realized volatility decays and the morning range is revisited. A fresh geopolitical discontinuity remains the main external re-acceleration risk.
Early afternoon remains WATCH with lower conditional Tail if price action is overlapping. Persistent same-direction extension from the morning extreme would be the main adverse exception.
The approach to power hour modestly raises Tail because late-session continuation can become directional. A balanced range and repeated retracements would keep the state contained.
Around the cash close, Tail remains WATCH unless closing flow holds a session extreme with little giveback. A two-sided close would preserve the lower path-risk regime.
During the futures maintenance interval, live path evidence is limited. Conditional Tail is low absent a new catalyst, while Stress remains high from the unresolved macro and geopolitical backdrop.
At the next Globex reopen, conditional Tail returns to WATCH because gaps can transmit new information quickly; a near-settlement open with rotation would argue against escalation.
Late Globex remains WATCH while the market establishes the next overnight range. Tail would rise only if directional extension persists with weak retracements and broader confirmation.

forecastDetail.comment: Near-flat Globex reopening keeps Tail at WATCH despite extreme macro and geopolitical Stress.
Two-sided early-Asia trade would keep Tail at the low end of WATCH; a persistent headline gap is the main invalidation.
Conditional Tail falls to low if early Asia stays rotational; persistent extension through pullback attempts would reverse that decline.
Mid-Asia remains low Tail under orderly rotation, with oil and yields acting as amplifiers only if NQ aligns directionally.
Late-Asia Tail stays low absent held extremes or repeated shallow retracements.
Europe handoff lifts Tail back to WATCH because a durable breakout could establish directional efficiency.
